messages:
maya: Heads-up: ran a quick sim for last week's us-west spike — our steady-slo autoscaler triggered a ton of cold starts and we burned a lot on burst GPUs. Need a short sync on guardrails.
kevin: Can you paste the numbers? cost diff and p95 delta?
olivia: also which region and spot/preemptible mix?
maya: Summary: 3h window, peak QPS +4x. Autoscaler launched ~120 burst GPUs, avg hold ~12m, extra spend ~$18k. p95 latency for chat endpoints went 220ms -> 450ms.
olivia: Oof. Were most burst GPUs preemptible? any fallbacks to other regions causing RTT spikes?
maya: Mostly preemptible in us-west1. When capacity hit, routing sent a fraction to eu-west which added ~120ms RTT on those requests. Also saw kube-scheduler backpressure during pod churn (lots of short-lived pods).
samir: Thinking out loud — a small warm pool + a conservative burst cap could reduce cold starts without overserving steady load. e.g., keep 10-15% warm pinned, cap burst multiplier to ~1.6-1.8, and add a short prewarm_delay to avoid scale on tiny spikes.
maya: I re-ran a sim with warm_pool=30, burst_multiplier=1.6, prewarm_delay=60s: cold starts down ~65%, p95 ~280ms, and cost delta -$7k vs current config.
kevin: Nice. Can we express that as operational guardrails: max_burst_per_cluster, warm_pool_target, and a circuit-breaker that disables burst if network error rate >2%?
olivia: Also add per-customer route smoothing — noisy tenants should be throttled before they cause cluster-wide bursts. per-route leaky bucket + smoothing window.
autoscale-bot: autoscale-bot: simulated rollout applied to staging — snapshot: warm_pool=30, burst_multiplier=1.6, network_error_breaker=2%
samir: Proposal: canary this config for 24h with traffic replay from the spike. Ops runbook: rollback if cold_start_rate >10% OR cost > baseline+20% OR p95 > 400ms for primary chat route.
maya: I will open a PR to eng-infra with the autoscaler policy + a dashboard tile for cold_start_rate and burst_cost_fraction.
kevin: Please include the config snippet in the PR. Quick sample to copy:
```
autoscaler:
  warm_pool_target: 30
  burst_multiplier: 1.6
  prewarm_delay_s: 60
  max_burst_gpu: 100
  network_error_breaker_pct: 2
  per_route_smoothing_window_s: 45
```
olivia: Add metric: fallback_latency_penalty tagged by region so we can see cross-region fallout.
maya: On it. I'll tag @samir for rollout ops and @kevin for sign-off. :thumbsup:
samir: sgtm. I'll kick off the canary traffic replay at 03:00 UTC tomorrow and watch dashboards.
autoscale-bot: autoscale-bot: canary scheduled for 1936080000 (03:00 UTC) — test replay attached.
